environmentVariables.description: Token used when the agent doesn't say: usdg or autonomo.
environmentVariables.name: AUTONOMO_PAY_WITH

environmentVariables.description: Most USDG the server will spend per UTC day.
environmentVariables.name: AUTONOMO_DAILY_USDG

environmentVariables.description: Most $AUTONOMO the server will spend per UTC day.
environmentVariables.name: AUTONOMO_DAILY_AUTONOMO

environmentVariables.description: Moodle site address (wwwroot), e.g. https://moodle.example.org
environmentVariables.name: MOODLE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Where moodle-mcp-login saves the token (path is resolved via homedir())
environmentVariables.name: MOODLE_TOKEN_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Web service token override (CI / smoke tests)
environmentVariables.name: MOODLE_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Chrome/Chromium binary for moodle-mcp-login (looked up in PATH by default)

environmentVariables.description: 1/true/yes/on enables debug output to stderr and debug level in the host log channel

server.name: io.github.avaazquezz/mcp-qdrant
server.description: The full Qdrant API as 58 MCP tools: plain-text semantic/BM25/hybrid search and a search advisor.
server.title: Qdrant MCP

environmentVariables.description: Qdrant server URL, e.g. http://localhost:6333 (mutually exclusive with QDRANT_LOCAL_PATH)
environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_URL

environmentVariables.description: Qdrant API key, if your instance requires one
environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Path to an embedded Qdrant instance, instead of a URL
environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_LOCAL_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable: core, search, payload, admin, snapshots, observability
environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_MCP_TOOLSETS

environmentVariables.description: Remove every tool not marked read-only from the registry
environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_MCP_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Largest number of points one tool call may ask for (minimum 30); bigger requests are refused, not cut
environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_MCP_MAX_LIMIT

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated http(s) origins qdrant_snapshot_recover may restore from, besides file:// and QDRANT_URL's own origin
environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_MCP_SNAPSHOT_ALLOWED_ORIGINS

environmentVariables.description: Where text-embedding models are cached (semantic search needs the mcp-qdrant[embeddings] extra)
environmentVariables.name: FASTEMBED_CACHE_PATH

server.name: io.github.avansaber/seo-monster
server.description: Local-first SEO MCP: track AI citations, Search Console, GA4, PageSpeed, Cloudflare, IndexNow, CrUX.

environmentVariables.description: Path to your Desktop-app OAuth client-secrets JSON, downloaded from Google Cloud Console. Required for Search Console, Indexing, and GA4 tools.
environmentVariables.name: SEO_MCP_GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT

environmentVariables.description: Writable path where the cached OAuth token is stored. On first use, a browser opens for one-time consent and the token is written here. Default: ${HOME}/.config/seo-monster/token.json
environmentVariables.name: SEO_MCP_GOOGLE_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Default Search Console property, e.g. 'sc-domain:example.com' or 'https://www.example.com/'.
environmentVariables.name: SEO_MCP_GSC_DEFAULT_SITE

environmentVariables.description: Default GA4 property, e.g. 'properties/123456789' or bare '123456789'.
environmentVariables.name: SEO_MCP_GA4_PROPERTY_ID

environmentVariables.description: Google API key shared by PageSpeed Insights and Chrome UX Report History tools. Optional; both work anonymously at a tighter rate limit when unset.
environmentVariables.name: PSI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Cloudflare API token. Optional; needed only for the Cloudflare tools. Scopes: Zone:Read, DNS:Read, Account Analytics:Read, and (only when destructive mode is on) Cache Purge:Purge, Single Redirect:Edit, Zone Settings:Edit, and (for bulk redirects) Account Rulesets:Edit + Account Filter Lists:Edit.
environmentVariables.name: CF_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Default Cloudflare zone hostname, e.g. 'example.com'.
environmentVariables.name: CF_ZONE

environmentVariables.description: IndexNow shared key (any 8-128 hex string you generate). Required only for the IndexNow tools. Host the key file at https://<your-host>/<key>.txt for engine verification.
environmentVariables.name: SEO_MCP_INDEXNOW_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Override the default IndexNow key-file URL (https://<host>/<key>.txt). Set only if you host the key file at a non-standard path.
environmentVariables.name: SEO_MCP_INDEXNOW_KEY_LOCATION

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to enable the Cloudflare cache-purge tools. Default false: all destructive tools refuse to run.
environmentVariables.name: SEO_MCP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE

environmentVariables.description: DataForSEO Basic-auth login. Optional (v0.9). Unlocks SERP/PAA/related, keyword volume+difficulty+intent, competitor keyword-gap, and Google AI Overview citations for keyword_universe / serp_adjacency_expand / onpage_serp_gap auto-fetch / ai_citation_track.
environmentVariables.name: DATAFORSEO_LOGIN

environmentVariables.description: DataForSEO Basic-auth password. Optional (v0.9). Required alongside DATAFORSEO_LOGIN.
environmentVariables.name: DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Open PageRank (DomCop) free API key. Optional (v0.9). Free competitor domain-authority proxy for onpage_serp_gap.
environmentVariables.name: OPENPAGERANK_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Perplexity Sonar API key. Optional (v0.9). One of the AI answer-engines for ai_citation_track.
environmentVariables.name: PERPLEXITY_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key (Responses web_search). Optional (v0.9). One of the AI answer-engines for ai_citation_track.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key (web_search tool). Optional (v0.9). One of the AI answer-engines for ai_citation_track.
environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Google Gemini API key (Search grounding). Optional (v0.9). One of the AI answer-engines for ai_citation_track.
environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Google Ads API developer token. Optional (v0.9). Volume-only alternative to DataForSEO for keyword_universe; live use also needs an adwords-scope OAuth re-consent.
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Google Ads customer id (digits). Optional (v0.9). Required alongside GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN.
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID
